question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase in the table row governed by footnote (*10), do the DAILY MAX column entries marked 'Report' establish enforceable numeric discharge limits subject to compliance comparison, or monitoring/reporting requirements for which no numeric compliance comparison is applicable?
required_context: Nominated table row showing numeric 30-DAY AVG limits (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) alongside DAILY MAX entries marked 'Report', each referencing footnote (*10)
Footnote (*8) defining net total dissolved solids as the difference between Outfall 001 discharge and flow-weighted average influent at the two drinking water treatment plants
Footnote (*10) stating that the limits apply from the permit effective date through three years thereafter
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page: 5, Section: part_i, table row (*10)
notes: The nominated row mixes enforceable numeric 30-DAY AVG limits with DAILY MAX 'Report' entries under the same footnote. Resolving whether those Report entries carry numeric compliance obligations changes which limits are enforceable for comparison (Purpose A) and how absent daily-max values should be classified among report-only monitoring versus missing compliance evidence (Purpose C).
